rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an enclosed path carrying electric current.

example.english: This circuit is broken, so the machine won't turn on.
example.traditional: 呢塊電路壞咗，部機開唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 din6 lou6 waai6 zo2 bou6 gei1 hoi1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a regular work route or appointed trip from place to place.

example.english: I follow this circuit every day to deliver goods.
example.traditional: 我每日都跟呢條路線送貨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 gan1 ni1 tiu4 lou6 sin3 sung3 fo3
